general_freeze_gate.candidate_generation: Generate candidate outlet cells only from independently located channel/confluence evidence and the local D8 drainage trace; do not search the basin for a cell that optimizes area, length, rainfall, or outcome agreement.
general_freeze_gate.identity_requirement: The selected cell must belong to the named tributary/drainage unit rather than the Rimac/Santa Eulalia mainstem or a neighboring tributary.
general_freeze_gate.reproducibility_requirement: Record source identifiers, source coordinates, DEM identity, code SHA, candidate cells, selected cell, distances and D8 trace diagnostics.
general_freeze_gate.sensitivity_requirement: If the source location spans more than one 30 m cell or is represented by an endpoint rather than an exact outlet, all admissible local source-cell alternatives must converge to the same downstream named-channel cell before FROZEN is permitted.
general_freeze_gate.contradiction_rule: Any independent static geometry contradiction keeps outlet_status=PENDING_REVIEW; numerical repeatability alone is insufficient.

predeclared_resolution_method.name: ANA_TWO_POINT_UPSTREAM_ANCHORED_D8_CHANNEL_SNAP
predeclared_resolution_method.step_1: Locate the DEM cell containing the ANA 2+180 upstream anchor and enumerate any immediately adjacent DEM cells required solely by coordinate-to-grid ambiguity.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_2: Trace D8 downstream from each admissible upstream source cell without using basin area, channel length, rainfall or outcome information.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_3: For each trace, identify the traced Cashahuacra-channel cell nearest the ANA 0+000 downstream anchor.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_4: Require all admissible upstream source-cell traces to converge to the same selected downstream cell; otherwise remain PENDING_REVIEW.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_5: After selection, compare trace orientation/location against the ANA static segment only as an identity contradiction check, never as an optimization objective.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_6: Only after identity PASS may the outlet and resulting basin geometry be marked FROZEN and passed to morphometry/IMERG jobs.
